judge.rationale: The candidate implementation appears to have stopped mid-way through its own Definition of Done (which was committed as `.lore/dod.md`). Several acceptance criteria are completely missing: there is no `WeakMap` caching for function-valued schemas, no log emitted on validation failure, and no updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts`. Several required tests are also absent (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema changes per call, unknown tool throwing, and the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`), and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` has uncited bullet points which will fail the repository's `re-lint/require-spec-link` rule. Additionally, the candidate uses default `import Ajv from 'ajv'` instead of named `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`, which commonly breaks TypeScript `NodeNext` compilation with `ajv` v8.
